description: This file defines the EnumFunction class, which extends Twig's FunctionExpression to handle enum-related functions in Twig templates. It includes logic to compile enum function calls, validate arguments, and generate code to access enum cases.

classes.name: EnumFunction
classes.description: Custom Twig function extension for handling enum types, validating arguments, and generating enum case code in templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the enum function call into PHP code, with validation of arguments and enum existence.
